name: laravel/laravel
description: The skeleton application for the Laravel framework.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1" "php artisan pail" "npm run dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite

scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Runs PHPStan from a cold tmpDir (phpstan.neon): under Docker Desktop its caches trust a stale directory stat and can skip new files.
scripts-descriptions.deptrac: Checks the layer and module map in deptrac.yaml.
scripts-descriptions.infection: Mutation-tests the Invoices module; fails below 100% covered MSI (infection.json5).
scripts-descriptions.deps:validate: Validates composer.json and the lock file, warnings included.
scripts-descriptions.deps:audit: Checks the locked packages for security advisories and abandoned packages (ignores: config.policy).
scripts-descriptions.deps:analyse: Finds used but undeclared dependencies, and unused ones in require; dev tools run as binaries and extensions it cannot see (composer-dependency-analyser.php).
scripts-descriptions.taint: Runs Psalm, which psalm.xml limits to taint analysis (runTaintAnalysis); type checks stay with PHPStan.
scripts-descriptions.api:export: Regenerates api.json, the OpenAPI document, with Scramble and fails on an unknown type. APP_NAME, APP_URL and API_VERSION reach the document, so the config cache is cleared and they are pinned here and in phpunit.xml.

ignore.symplify/rule-doc-generator-contracts: Dev-only, required by driftingly/rector-laravel for its rule descriptions; goes when rector-laravel drops it.
